name: Aura Premium Birch Plywood
description: Multi-layered Nordic Birch plywood offering outstanding strength, uniform surface finish, and minimal core voids. Perfect for bespoke high-end furniture, detailed joinery, and premium architectural millwork.

name: Nautica Marine Plywood (BWP)
description: Boiling Water Proof (BWP) marine grade plywood engineered to withstand harsh marine environments and high humidity. Bonded with premium synthetic resins to prevent delamination.
features: Tested under high pressure and boiling water

name: Imperial Smoked Walnut Veneer
description: Exquisite smoked walnut wood veneer offering deep chocolate tones and striking golden highlights. Sliced with high precision to preserve the rich, natural grain flow for high-end interior panelling.

name: Vanguard Tactile Oak Laminate
description: Ultra-matte high pressure laminate (HPL) with an anti-fingerprint surface and tactile wood grain texture. Offers the realistic beauty of European oak with outstanding scratch and heat resistance.

name: Ecoluxe High-Density MDF
description: Ultra-refined high-density fiberboard (HDF/MDF) constructed from fine softwood fibers. Provides incredibly smooth edges and surfaces, perfect for high-gloss lacquering and CNC profile milling.

name: Stark Solid Core Block Board
description: Premium block board featuring a solid pine wood core sandwiched between cross-banded hardwood veneers. Exceptional bending strength and lightness makes it the preferred material for long shelves, doors, and wide tables.

name: Linear Fluted Decorative Panel
description: Luxurious fluted architectural wall panels designed to introduce texture, depth, and acoustical dampening to high-end residential and commercial lobbies. Finished in a gorgeous natural white oak.

specs.Wood Species: White Oak veneer on black MDF

name: Bespoke Curved Architectural Slats
description: Tailor-made curved wood structures and custom ceiling installations engineered to match architectural drawing specifications. Prefabricated sections ensure rapid site assembly and stunning visual flow.

specs.Materials: Flexible plywood backing / Solid wood slat inserts
specs.Finish Options: UV Lacquer, Oil finish, fire-retardant coat
specs.Origin: Custom built in our master workshop

features: Complies with commercial building fire codes
